newsitem.title: USA: BOXING-CLINTON 'HORRIFIED' BY TYSON BITE FIGHT.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-CLINTON 'HORRIFIED' BY TYSON BITE FIGHT.

text.p: President Bill Clinton said on Monday he was "horrified" when former boxing heavyweight champion Mike Tyson bit both of Evander Holyfield's ears in a title fight Saturday in Las Vegas.

"I saw the fight and until (the biting incident) happened, it was a good fight, and I was horrified by it, and I think the American people are," Clinton said when asked his personal reaction to the ear-chomping incident.

Asked by reporters on the White House lawn what the federal role should be in regulating such fights, Clinton replied, "I don't know what the federal role should be (in regulating boxing), I've not give that any thought whatever. As a fan, I was horrified."
The Holyfield-Tyson rematch for the World Boxing Association heavyweight title ended after three rounds on Saturday when Tyson was disqualified for twice biting the champion's ears.
The Nevada State Athletic Commission said it was withholding Tyson's $30 million purse for the fight and would hold a meeting on Tuesday to decide whether to fine him or take more serious action.
